title: Business demography and high growth enterprises by NACE Rev. 2 activity and NUTS 3 region

dimensions.label: Economic indicator for structural business statistics

options.label: Enterprises - number
Enterprise births - number
Size of newly born enterprises - persons employed in newly born enterprises divided by enterprise births - average number
Employment in enterprise deaths - persons employed in enterprise deaths divided by enterprise deaths - average number
Enterprise deaths - number
Size of 3 year old enterprises - persons employed in enterprises newly born 3 years back and survived divided by the same enterprises - average number
Enterprise survivals (3-calendar year survival only) - number
3 years old survived enterprises’ share of the business population - percentage
Survival rate - 3 years old enterprise survivals divided by enterprise births three years ago - percentage
High-growth enterprises measured in employment - number
Share of high growth enterprises, measured in employment - high growth enterprises divided by active enterprises with at least 10 employees - percentage
Business churn - birth and death rate - percentage
Birth rate - enterprise births divided by active enterprises - percentage
Death rate - enterprise deaths divided by active enterprises - percentage
Net business population growth - percentage
Persons employed - number
Persons employed in newly born enterprises - number
Employment share of enterprise births - persons employed in newly born enterprises divided by persons employed in active enterprises - percentage
Persons employed in enterprise deaths - number
Persons employed in enterprises survivals (3-calendar year survival only) - number
Persons employed in enterprises survivals, in the year of birth (3-calendar year survival only) - number
Employment share of enterprise deaths - persons employed in enterprise deaths divided by persons employed in active enterprises - percentage
Employment share of 3 year old enterprises - persons employed in enterprises newly born 3 years back and survived, divided by persons employed in the population of active enterprises - percentage
3 years old survived enterprises employment growth rate - persons employed in enterprise 3 years survivals divided by persons employed in the same enterprises in the year of birth - percentage
Employees - number
Employees in newly born enterprises - number
Employees in enterprise deaths - number
New enterprise paid employment rate - employees in newly born enterprises divided by persons employed in newly born enterprises - percentage
